text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Passing the 400m mark! The Umamusume are 
making their move all at once!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Fuhahahaha!! Hahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(How fierce, chains of fate!! Binding me 
this tight—are you really that afraid of 
me?! Well, too bad for you――――)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I already know how to sever you!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Turn to duuuuust!!!!!
(SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet in the lead!! Tanino Gimlet 
takes the lead————!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahahaaa!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What a glorious, bloody battle that 
was...! This surging heartbeat is proof of 
it...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A celebratory toast to all warriors!! And 
to the observers—a dazzling brilliance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What an utterly outrageous guy!! 
Running so completely wild makes me want 
to laugh!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now that's the "God of Destruction" 
for ya...! Thanks to you, I feel like 
takin' on an even bigger challenge myself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Shall we set sail? In search of a new 
sea.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To get even bigger— so I can turn 
the whole world upside down, gods and all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the heat, "God of 
Destruction"!! To you, who burns like the 
sun——cheers!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Gimlet-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Clashing with your running 
style... made me feel reborn, too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What I can do... the path I should take—I 
was able to find it once again...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—O hero of the present, or perhaps of some 
distant time. At the end of the epic poem 
you weave, awaits a confrontation with a 
great "ordeal"...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the chaos that 
bloody battle will bring. Though—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Though the end of all things, where the 
God of Destruction tramples everything 
underfoot, may very well await us.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then all that's left is to raise my sword 
and face the challenge—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
One day, clad in true brilliance, I will 
face the "trials" brought forth by "God." 
As the one and only hero...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahahaha! The prophecy has been forged 
here!! Let us eagerly await the promised 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Heh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Next.

The ruin brought by the "God of 
Destruction" will shatter all destiny and 
lead countless souls toward a brand-new 
world.

What waits ahead is surely— a lovable 
chaos that someone once "dreamed" of.
